description: This Java class 'InlineJobExecuteHandler' handles the execution of inline jobs within the Fineract infrastructure. It implements the 'NewCommandSourceHandler' interface and processes commands to execute specific inline jobs based on their name. It retrieves the appropriate executor service from the application context and executes the job, handling exceptions if the job is not found or not enabled.

classes.name: InlineJobExecuteHandler
classes.description: A Spring service class that handles execution of inline jobs based on commands, identifying and invoking the appropriate executor service for a given job name.

methods.name: processCommand
methods.description: Processes the incoming command to execute a specific inline job by resolving its executor service from the application context and invoking its execution method.
